It is currently the **generated production ontology**, not the temporary stub.  
The temporary `ontologies/architecture.ttl` was retired (commit `7f015a32`), replaced by `ontologies/software-architecture.ttl` (with `software-architecture_shapes.ttl`), generated by Trivyn v0.8.0 from the architecture brief and using the Trivyn namespace (`https://trivyn.io/ontologies/software/architecture/domain/`).
